summary: Extract evidence-backed commercial invoice rows and equipment tariff matrices without inventing missing facts.
acceptance: Visible invoice rows preserve quantities, billed currency amounts, original tariff prices, negatives and equipment grouping.
Commercial quotation matrix rates remain separated by equipment/currency; duplicate recaps and uncertain prices cannot become verified amounts.
Provider absence, source incompleteness, acceptance, route scope and date basis remain honest unknowns.
Parser version permits new analysis from existing stored text without rewriting historical runs; no private source data is published.
semanticRouting: Bounded commercial parsing, additive monetary/source contracts, nested evidence validation, invoice rule safety and display of distinct rate/billed amounts. No new dependency or external AI; sensitive documents stay local.
